_note: Public template. Copy to axon-overlay/config/calendar.json and fill real values there — never here. calendar resolves config from $SJEL_CALENDAR_CONFIG > $SJEL_PERSONAL_ROOT/config/calendar.json > capabilities/calendar/calendar.config.json at runtime (see src/config.rs Config::load). Phases A–D need no file at all; only the Google sync (Phase E) reads one. There is no database key: PRD Q45 made the store path a deployment fact ($SJEL_DB_PATH, else $SJEL_PERSONAL_ROOT/data/axon/axon.db), because a file per capability would drop the cross-capability joins the shared instance existed for.
_comment_port: HTTP port for calendar-server (default 8087). SJEL_PORT from the service runner wins, then SJEL_CALENDAR_PORT, then this.
_comment_home_timezone: The one zone every stored wall time is in (README § Time model). DECLARE IT ONCE, in the overlay's config/deployment.env as SJEL_HOME_TIMEZONE (schemas/deployment.env.example) — scouting needs the same value, and two independent copies agree until one is edited. Setting it here still overrides, but a value that disagrees with the deployment declaration is an error naming both files, not a precedence rule. NO DEFAULT either way: Google events carry a real UTC offset, and converting them with the wrong zone writes every import silently an hour or more off. Both the import and the export refuse until it resolves. Accepts UTC, a fixed ±HH:MM offset, or one of the supported IANA zones listed in src/zone.rs.
_comment_markdown_sources: Declared sources of markdown event notes, for the reviewed import (README § Markdown event import). Empty by default and disabled here on purpose: a note store is something you point calendar at, never something it goes looking for. 'id' becomes the entry source, so it must be 1-40 chars of [a-z0-9_]; 'path' is the root, with '~/' expanded; 'events_glob' is bounded relative to that root and may name one exact file. A glob that climbs out with '..' is refused rather than followed. Nothing is ever written back to the notes, and no entry is written at all without an explicit selection of ids that a preview returned.
_comment_google: Phase E, Google Calendar two-way sync. calendar_id has NO DEFAULT — 'primary' is the account's own calendar, a secondary one is its long …@group.calendar.google.com id; guessing would sync the wrong calendar. env_path points at a KEY=value file holding GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID / GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET / GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN, defaulting to $SJEL_PERSONAL_ROOT/config/calendar.env. capabilities/comms/auth/get-refresh-token.ts already mints a token with the calendar.events scope, so pointing env_path at comms.env reuses that grant instead of creating a second one. Never put a token value in this file.
